The decision record states the choice and the alternatives. The body has `Process change: yes`. Current upstream AGENTS.md assigns the version change to the merging session.

Local results:

- Reviewed the whole diff. Trial merge with upstream/main `aef12fea67e0082e7ba835a3d9fcade8e2c11eb0` passed. The first parent is the PR head named above.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/tests -v`: 10 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 0 selected steps, 0 failed. This selected no Rust tests.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The release build passed. Motion lib: 7 passed. Each of `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start`: 1 passed. Total: 11 tests passed. Wall time: 11.4 minutes.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD`: passed.
- Extra suites run: the Python documentation suite named above. No changed fixture, importer, post, operation, motion, or catalog requires an extra Rust suite.

Requested before merge: none.

Scope and limits: This PR changes documentation and its tests. It changes no Rust behavior, posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision check. No UI screenshots or moved goldens apply. No safety mutations were required or run. Clippy and full heavy lanes were not run. No GitHub runner was used. The local review worktree and branch remain for the next review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
